title: SCOUT cohort
text: SPN06 prototype smoking-associated lung adenocarcinoma, 6 clones compete time two lines treatment. main clonal population driven mutant TP53 STK11, manifests two subclones: one associated EGFR amplification, one KEAP1 mutation. Upon chemo-immunotherapy (leaves mutational signature), KRAS-driven subclone drives relapse, whereas two subclones eradicated treatment. Upon second line chemotherapy (leave mutational signature), resistance driven aquired amplification mutant KRAS allele. SPN06 profiled three time-points, treatment relapse treatment. two diagnostic biopsies polyclonal, whereas relapse biopsies monoclonal.
